theme: The Neurobiology of Consistency & Friction Engineering
target_audience: Thinkers, self-taught creators, students, and ambitious individuals battling procrastination and burnout
title_candidates: THE CONSISTENCY PARADOX | An Animated Short Film
Why You Can't Stay Consistent (It's Not Discipline) | An Animated Short Film
THE 2-SECOND RULE | An Animated Short Film

originality_audit.unique_intellectual_angle: Exposes why brute willpower inevitably triggers a neurochemical immune response (homeostatic resistance), reframing consistency not as emotional motivation or military discipline, but as thermodynamic friction reduction and identity-ledger micro-momentum.
banned_cliches_purged: You just have to want it bad enough
original_metaphors_introduced: The Homeostatic Alarm (Brain treating drastic change as famine/threat)
The Boulder vs The Riverbed (Brute force vs carved channel)
The Friction Tax (Every second of hesitation burns 15% prefrontal glucose)
The Identity Ledger (Voting for the person who sits down, not the end result)
The 20-Second Moat (Physical barrier separating desire from relapse)
academic_or_empirical_sources: Roy Baumeister - Ego Depletion and Glucose Dynamics in Volitional Control
B.J. Fogg - Behavior Model (B = MAP: Motivation, Ability, Prompt)
George Ainslie - Breakdown of Will & Hyperbolic Discounting Curves
Robert Sapolsky - Prefrontal Cortex Modulation under Homeostatic Stress

core_psychological_thesis: Consistency is not an act of willpower; it is the deliberate elimination of choice. The moment you require emotional motivation to sit at your desk, you have already lost.

narrative_arc.act_1_the_setup: The 2:00 AM declaration of intense discipline, followed by the catastrophic Day 4 collapse.
narrative_arc.act_2_the_biological_engine: Why the brain perceives sudden drastic life overhauls as a threat to survival and triggers the Homeostatic Alarm.
narrative_arc.act_3_the_paradox_revealed: The myth of the high-discipline superhuman. Why consistent people actually exert less willpower than chronic quitters.
narrative_arc.act_4_the_friction_architecture: The 20-Second Moat and Carving the Riverbed. How to engineer the environment so friction does the heavy lifting.
narrative_arc.act_5_the_sovereign_resolution: The Identity Ledger: You do not need to feel ready, you only need to show up and cast one vote.

actionable_sovereignty_rule: Never negotiate with yourself in the moment of action. Reduce the initial friction until resistance becomes ridiculous, sit in the chair, and let momentum do the rest.
